links.outcome: Change in musculoskeletal health (MSK-HQ) at 3 months, AI app vs usual care and vs web-based e-Help
links.effect: Adjusted mean MSK-HQ difference between app and usual care was 0.62 points (95% CI -1.66 to 2.90; P=.60); app vs e-Help was 1.08 points (95% CI -1.24 to 3.41; P=.36). No significant benefit.
links.quote: In the intention-to-treat analysis at 3 months, the adjusted mean difference in MSK-HQ score between the app and usual care groups was 0.62 points (95% CI, -1.66 to 2.90 points; P = .60).

screen.reason: Randomized clinical trial evaluating the clinical effectiveness of an AI-based digital self-management app (SELFBACK) compared to web-based support or usual care alone; does not test a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
